items.title: Updated: Sustainability leadership moves
items.summary: As corporate sustainability matures, some long-time leaders are leaving the profession, while others are tackling a broader set of responsibilities following reorganizations or layoffs.

items.title: How a Chinese state-owned trader became the climate leader among ag giants
items.summary: Over the past 20 years, China has combined manufacturing might with industrial policy to dominate solar power and other climate technologies.

items.title: One week left to register: How to prepare for the UK Sustainability Reporting Standards
items.summary: This webinar, hosted in partnership with Simply Sustainable on 10 November, will explore how businesses can prepare for the UK Sustainability Reporting Standards (UK SRS), understand their current level of readiness and turn gaps into a practical implementation plan.

items.title: Half of retailers write off up to 40% of returns, research finds
items.summary: Despite tightening EU regulations on circularity, new research has revealed that half of retailers write off, destroy or discard between 6-40% of returned items.

items.title: COP31: Brazil unveils fossil fuel and deforestation Roadmaps ahead of summit
items.summary: As first announced in Belém last year, the COP30 Presidency has now launched its long-awaited international Roadmaps to accelerate the energy transition and protect forests.

items.title: Apply now: Entries open for the edie Awards 2027
items.summary: The UK’s largest corporate sustainability awards scheme is celebrating its 20th year with a restructured programme, built around three pillars and new categories including AI, water and adaptation.

items.title: More money, wrong direction? The World Bank’s climate finance dilemma
items.summary: With the Annual Meetings of the World Bank and IMF wrapped up, Inès Urman, climate campaigner at the Environmental Investigation Agency (EIA), argues that mobilising more private finance is not enough.

items.title: Report: SMEs face $1trn green finance gap
items.summary: Globally, small businesses require more than $1.1trn in funding to help decarbonise and become more sustainable, but 80% of organisations that have explored grants and investment options do not apply.

items.title: Watch on-demand: How AI can unlock investment in climate solutions
items.summary: Discover how businesses can use AI, market intelligence and expert insight to identify credible climate investment opportunities, strengthen financial business cases and turn sustainability ambitions into funded action, with this free webinar, available to watch on-demand.

items.title: WEBINAR ON THURSDAY: What SMEs need to know before investing in solar
items.summary: Taking place on 5 November, this upcoming webinar will explore how SMEs can overcome the financial and practical barriers to onsite solar and maximise the return on their investment.
